summary: 化工企业厂区属于高风险区域，遍布易燃易爆设施，低空安防核心是实现无人机的预警与精准处置，严防无人机侵入引发安全或窃密事故。系统以防爆为首要原则，在核心区域划定电子围栏、部署智能光电转台，借助红外热成像实现24小时监测。通过AI算法识别无人机后，立即发出最高级别告警并追踪轨迹，保障厂区安全。
summary_en: Chemical plants are high-risk areas filled with flammable and explosive facilities. The core of low-altitude security is achieving early warning and precise disposal of UAVs to prevent accidents or theft. Following explosion-proof principles, the system establishes electronic fences and deploys intelligent optoelectronic turntables for 24/7 monitoring using infrared thermal imaging. Once AI algorithms identify a drone, highest-level alerts are issued and trajectories tracked to ensure plant safety.
key_parameter_1: 防爆安防策略: 在核心高风险区域划定电子围栏，确保24小时探测
key_parameter_1_en: Explosion-proof Policy: Establishing electronic fences in core areas for 24/7 detection
key_parameter_2: 安全反制手段: 优先采用导航欺骗、定向压制等非接触式处置方式
key_parameter_2_en: Safe Countermeasures: Preferential use of non-contact disposal like nav-decoy and directional suppression
detail_html:
方案详解

系统协同实现全流程自动化运行，能够适配全天候复杂场景，高效抵御各类低空非法无人机威胁。采用分层应用策略，外围部署无线电侦测设备定位无人机操控者，预警区启用导航欺骗驱离无人机。

  • 全流程自动化预警处置
  • 防爆外壳设计，适应危化环境
  • AI算法自动捕捉追踪
detail_html_en:
Detailed Solution

The system collaborates for fully automated operation, adapting to all-weather complex scenarios and efficiently resisting low-altitude illegal UAV threats. Using a layered strategy, wireless sensors locate pilots at the periphery, while decoy systems drive away drones in the warning zone.

  • Fully automated alerting and disposal
  • Explosion-proof casing for hazardous environments
  • AI algorithms for auto capture and tracking
